title: GitScholar: A Dataset for Predicting AI Research Impact from GitHub Engagement
abstract: arXiv:2609.26361v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With the rapid pace of AI research and the hundreds of daily new publications, staying up-to-date with the latest developments has become increasingly difficult. For researchers, quickly identifying impactful work is essential, yet manually reviewing each new publication is impractical. Automated impact prediction methods help address this challenge, usually by combining various information sources available, such as a paper's content or citation history. translated_title: GitScholar：一个基于GitHub互动预测AI研究影响力的数据集
translated_abstract: 随着AI研究的快速发展和每天数百篇新论文的发表，紧跟最新进展变得越来越困难。对于研究人员来说，快速识别有影响力的工作至关重要，但人工审查每一篇新论文并不现实。自动化影响力预测方法有助于应对这一挑战，通常通过结合各种可用的信息源，如论文内容或引用历史。在这项工作中，我们提出使用GitHub互动作为额外的信息源，并证明它提供了一个及时且准确的信号。为此，我们引入了GitScholar，这是一个新颖的数据集，将444,000个GitHub仓库的活动与超过558,000篇AI arXiv论文关联起来。我们的实验表明，GitHub互动反应相比强大的学术基线可将早期预测精度提高最多12%。此外，我们发现GitHub信号对高影响力论文提供了近乎完全的覆盖。
tldr: 该论文提出GitScholar数据集，将44.4万个GitHub仓库的活动与超过55.8万篇AI arXiv论文关联，证明GitHub互动信号能将AI研究影响力的早期预测精度提升最多12%，并对高影响力论文提供近乎完全的覆盖。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GitScholar, a dataset linking GitHub activity from 444,000 repositories to over 558,000 AI arXiv papers, demonstrating that GitHub engagement improves early AI research impact prediction precision by up to 12% and provides near-complete coverage of high-impact papers.
